_comment: English version of news.json. source: 'ri' (Rotary International), 'distrito' (District 4740) or 'clube' (our club). Keep entries in the same order/dates as news.json.
titulo: Create Lasting Impact: the 2026-27 Rotary year theme
resumo: Rotary International President Olayinka H. Babalola calls on members to go beyond one-off actions, making clubs more welcoming and driving projects with sustainable impact in communities.

titulo: Donation of two adapted tricycles unites Rotary Alvorada, Ailos CrediComin and volunteers for inclusion in Lages
resumo: Rotary Club of Lages-Alvorada, District 4740, receives adapted equipment for the "Pernas Solidárias" project, expanding participation of people with disabilities in races and sporting events.

titulo: Governor couple 2026-27, Moacir Schaly and Maria Cristina Thibes Schaly, bring District 4740 closer to clubs during Official Visit
resumo: Another chapter in the Official Visits agenda reinforces the commitment to being present alongside the clubs of District 4740.

titulo: Crossing borders: RC Porto União – União da Vitória visits Rotary Club Milano Fiera Porta Nuova, in Milan
resumo: Rotary fellowship without borders: club members had the honor of taking part in a meeting of the Rotary Club Milano Fiera Porta Nuova, in Italy.
